mission_04: Mixup is a powerful data augmentation technique that creates new training samples by taking convex combinations of pairs of existing samples and their labels. For two samples (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), mixup generates x_mix = lambda * x1 + (1-lambda) * x2 and y_mix = lambda * y1 + (1-lambda) * y2, where lambda is sampled from a Beta distribution. This encourages the model to behave linearly between training examples, improving generalization and robustness. In this mission, you will implement mixup from scratch and observe how it creates soft labels and interpolated feature vectors.
